interfaceProposal.selectionMeaning: No owner/approved/path/hash/FD/worker config/prepared fields accepted. UUIDs never grant access: use(ctx, unique IDs, fission, consumer) obtains and verifies real current owned material leases. No new material catalog or native project-format storage.
interfaceProposal.privateAdmission: Append internal prepared-output claim operation reusing existing authority/contentParts/claimReply/RPC guards. Per-index child key is a deterministic hash of parent key + native Index (not a new random key); request fingerprint includes original complete batch body/source selection. Existing prepareAndClaim single-plan behavior preserved.
interfaceProposal.returnSemantics: 202 operation reference + original-index states/claim references. rendered-unverified is execution fact ONLY; executionReady/deliveryVerified never true before the next verifier. No raw server absolute artifact paths returned as access capabilities.

actualConsumer: Validate verified context, exact request/source-selection shape, native role/kind and group-component constraints. Fresh group/preflight gate before input work. Open an owned per-subject/environment/key attempt marker with wx before any worker. Same live request joins existing task; seen/uncertain receipt never reruns prepare.

Prepare phase calls actual materials.use for all explicitly selected input IDs. Copy bytes FROM leased FDs (not client paths), with abort checks, sync and hash/metadata checks into fresh inputs outside sibling worker writable root. Original FD stays provider-owned; close staged writable FD before C# read-only pinning. No normal material files modified.

Capture raw request job and effective original FissionJob separately. Only IO directory/OutDir adaptation is recorded; no new Job DTO, no Count1 rewrite. Persist complete immutable snapshot + native digest and job file hashes before any claim.

Build private tuple associations only for known staged destinations from material lease versionId + resolvedMeta. C# fileIdentity is copied verbatim ONLY from this actual prepare process Versions entry after path/SHA/stage-manifest checks; it was read on Windows by PreparedFileIdentity.GetFileInformationByHandle. Never synthesize it from Node ino/dev, a prior sample or client JSON.

Map each actual output.Index with committed mapPreparedFissionOutput using original request job/native projectId+rev and trusted associations. End initial use only after its fresh permission/FD post-check. No group claim from executed sidecar or fake measured/applied flags.

Each original Index gets deterministic idempotent fresh preflight/freeze_claim. Do not equate duplicate index0 with whole-batch duplicate. Only definite newly reserved/otherwise proven current own attempt outputs enter fresh start_attempt with recorded nonce. Returned frozen plan/contentKey must match the immutable mapped facts; unknown/denied mismatches never execute.

Reacquire materials.use for ONLY the union of actually admitted plans material IDs before execute, so excluded-only materials cannot invalidate accepted work after preparation. Recheck current metadata/rights, link lease signals and bounded verified-session/material-expiry cancellation. Use same original effectivejob/snapshot/digest and --outputs [original indices] once; no reroll/reselection/independent per-output workers.

Original CLI subset child stdinEOF cooperatively cancels; retain actual promises until exit+close and stream EOF, then allow provider FDs to close. Owner-bound close/status/cancel must drain real children and material operations. Preserve partial work and logs; mark actually uncertain attempts unknown when authority permits, else preserve local unconfirmed state. Never invent release or success.

On actual exit0, check the owned report/indices/artifact bounds and preserve the real MP4+edit-plan candidates. Stop at rendered-unverified: no record_delivery call, no history success, no Studio import/export claim until real verifier/native handoff is implemented.

persistenceBoundary.minimumNow: Owned wx request marker + raw/effective job pair + exact prepare snapshot/digest + per-index claim/nonces + actual child lifecycle are the no-reroll barrier. Existing marker after restart/uncertain transition returns needs-reconciliation, not automatic retry/release.
persistenceBoundary.notClaimed: No claim that a complete cross-host batch index/restart reconciliation UI/verified delivery ledger is done. Same coordinator root must retain its evidence; multiple-independent-host prepare races require a separate atomic admission decision if that deployment is introduced.

generatedAndFx.generated: Preserve native generated CountN facts and files. New generated voice has no existing licensed material version merely because native origin proof exists. Missing real registration/review/license -> explicit authorization-pending, preserved same snapshot, no fake UUID or default license, no execution of those outputs. Actual origin-policy material registration/authorization remains necessary; do not silently replace generated with existing voice.
generatedAndFx.fx: Preserve known intents; existing mapper source-tail pending and unknown ASS/GLSL cases remain explicit. Public standard runtime smoke may be no-FX, not a deletion of fullFX target.

rootRulings.decision: Six rather than four sources: extend only existing resolve_materials response with finite authNotAfter from original identity() result, recheck after any rights lock wait. Existing material notAfter already includes license/binding; no new schema/RPC/permission/secret or auth bypass. Keep old callers compatible.
rootRulings.why: VerifiedSession contains JWT expiry only; auth.sessions.not_after can be earlier. Dispatcher must actually bound child EOF cancellation by min(real auth cutoff, applicable material/binding notAfter, original context), no invented grace/after-the-fact success. Supabase existing parser preserves extra fields so supabase/material sources remain immutable.
